record.summary: TC260 technical document setting baseline security requirements for providers of generative AI services. It covers training-data (corpus) safety, model safety and safety measures, sets out the safety assessment that providers carry out, and gives the competent oversight departments a reference for judging the safety level of a service. It names more than 30 specific safety risks, including algorithmic bias, disclosure of personal information and copyright infringement, and requires a supply-chain security assessment of the hardware and software underlying models.
record.notes: Released 29 Feb 2024 after a preliminary draft of October 2023, as technical documentation designed to inform a national standard. Its content was taken up in the recommended national standard GB/T 45654-2025 (CN-10), published 25 Apr 2025 and effective 1 Nov 2025. The secondary URL is an unofficial English translation by CSET.

verification.note: CAUTION: not confirmed on an official page. The official URL now serves the redesigned TC260 homepage, with no trace of the document, in all three stored forms (http copy, browser-rendered copy and print PDF of 14 Oct 2026). Title, original title, issuer, release date (29 Feb 2024) and the document's reference character are confirmed only by the stored CSET translation page (secondary). The identifier TC260-003 is not in any stored file. 'Superseded' is a judgment: CSET describes the document as designed to inform a future national standard, and GB/T 45654-2025 (CN-10, level A) took up its content; no formal TC260 withdrawal notice was found. The original PDF link cited by CSET (tc260.org.cn/upload/2024-03-01/...) now also returns the homepage. Copies requested from perma.cc and c-csa.cn could not be stored.

National Standard of the People's Republic of China: Cybersecurity Technology – Basic Safety Requirements for Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (Draft for Feedback)

legal_force.quote: This document applies to service providers carrying out safety assessments and improving their safety levels, and also provides the relevant main oversight department (主管部门) a reference for judging the safety levels of generative AI services.

judgment.status_reasoning: Events: TC260 released the technical document on 29 Feb 2024 (CSET metadata). CSET describes it as 'designed to inform a future Chinese national standard on the topic' and lists a later draft national standard with the same title (Draft for Feedback, translated December 2024). The register's CN-10 record (level A, from SAMR pages stored for CN-10) shows that standard published as GB/T 45654-2025 on 25 Apr 2025, in effect from 1 Nov 2025. The stored files show no withdrawal notice. A technical document whose content has been taken up in a national standard in force is replaced in practice, so 'Superseded' stays as a judgment. The status rests on secondary evidence in this record's own files.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope without a scope note: a government standards committee's technical document on the safety and security of generative AI services.
